content.short: HyperGPT is an AI-driven platform that provides marketplaces and tools for decentralized AI services on TON.
content.description: HyperGPT is at the forefront of the intersection between artificial intelligence and blockchain technology, providing a comprehensive marketplace for decentralized AI services. Its platform enables developers and businesses to access, integrate, and monetize AI tools and models through a secure and transparent on-chain infrastructure, including support for the TON blockchain. By leveraging the benefits of decentralization, HyperGPT aims to democratize access to cutting-edge AI technology, fostering an open ecosystem where AI services are more accessible, verifiable, and efficient.
content.meta: Access decentralized AI tools with HyperGPT. The bridge between AI and TON, featured on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
